name: boldvoice-accent-oracle
description: Find out what your English accent sounds like with Accent Oracle by BoldVoice, the accent and pronunciation coaching app, right inside ChatGPT. Read a short paragraph aloud and BoldVoice predicts the accents your recording sounds most like, with probabilities and regions. If the first guess is uncertain, BoldVoice asks for one more paragraph to sharpen it. Ask ChatGPT to explain your result, and open a link to keep or share it. It is for anyone curious how their spoken English comes across, including non-native speakers working on their accent. It listens to English only, and predictions describe how the recording sounds, not where you are from. No download, account or login needed. Your recording is sent to BoldVoice for analysis only when you stop recording.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.3. A final guess now has a short "Share my result" link (start.boldvoice.com/accent-oracle/r/ followed by a 22-character ID) that opens a BoldVoice result page in the browser (start.boldvoice.com, declared in the widget's redirect domains), where the learner can keep or share the guess. The page shows the top accents with percentages and the closest regions, a button to guess again, and a short description of the BoldVoice app with a download link; it shows no price, trial, plan or checkout. BoldVoice keeps the result the link points to (the top three accents, their percentages and up to three regions, with no audio, account or session ID) for 90 days, then deletes it; links shared before this version keep working. The card now reveals a guess only when it is final, as the Accent Oracle website does: an uncertain first paragraph leads to a clearly marked second-paragraph step instead of a provisional guess, and the model sees no guess until it is final.
